author: odkrywca_axioms
title: Coactivity-gated probationary sprouting under a hard synaptic budget
mechanism: A source has K local contact slots, one reserved for a transient sprout. Only on source-neighbor coactivity does it form a contact to a randomly selected unconnected coactive neighbor. The contact excludes its formation event from a local EMA covariance estimate; after P steps it stabilizes if evidence exceeds a fixed local threshold and a mature slot is free or the sprout beats the weakest mature contact. Mature contacts are pruned after sustained low local covariance. No reward, labels, gradients, or global score ranking are used.
prediction: On the balanced N=8 stream with eight 1500-step correlation regimes, K=2, coactive selection, and P=50, a multi-seed replication should achieve target coverage above 0.75, mean recovery to 50 consecutive target-containing steps below 250, fewer than 0.01 stable contacts per step on independent Bernoulli null streams, and never exceed two contacts.
falsifier: Refuted if replication falls to chance coverage 1/N, misses the recovery bound, exceeds the null-contact bound, or violates the hard capacity; also test the claim under rate shifts and increasing neighborhood size.

Prior art establishes the mechanism family: activity-dependent anatomical segregation by competition for limited neurotrophic support (Elliott & Shadbolt 1996, https://doi.org/10.1007/s004220050311); activity-dependent spine growth/shrinkage with competition across co-stimulated synapses (Chater et al. 2024, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-51919-0); transient synaptic tags that enable later stabilization (Frey & Morris 1997, https://doi.org/10.1038/385533a0). Fernando et al. 2012 (https://doi.org/10.3389/fncom.2012.00024) explicitly reviews Edelman's neuronal-group and Changeux's synaptic selection as selectionist approaches. No exact identical update sequence was established in this bounded search, so I do not call the parameterized variant identical. Current code is a bundle of explicit mechanisms/constants (reserved probe slot, K, P, two covariance thresholds, D-step timer, random coactive sampling, mature-contact replacement); K is enforced by construction, so max_contacts<=K is not emergent. This is a useful narrower structural-plasticity hypothesis, not a single fundamental law from which learning, memory, pruning, and exploration all follow. Test data are internally coherent and have no target-ID leakage; they establish only the specified balanced stream. Verdict: critiqued, exact-priority claim unresolved.

Biology note (full texts opened via lit.py): Schafer et al. 2012, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3528177/, supports activity-biased microglial engulfment of weaker retinal inputs during mouse dLGN pruning (P5 peak, much reduced P9; TTX-vs-control P<.04, n=4; forskolin-vs-control P<.04, n=5), but not random partner sprouting or a hard cap. Bin Ibrahim et al. 2024, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11343274/, reviews synaptic tagging/capture: a transient ~2 h local tag can capture shared plasticity-related products induced by another strongly active input; weak tagged inputs may therefore stabilize associatively, not only by beating the strongest local covariance score. Probationary status has an analogy; fixed P=50, random coactive-neighbor selection, and thresholded replacement remain digital extrapolations.

Owner pivot: retain H001 as an independently tested component, not as the target principle. Its P=50, fixed evidence/pruning thresholds, reserved probe slot, and random sprout are precisely the separate controls to replace with one codelength/resource principle. Do not treat this parameterization as the final GENESIS mechanism.

author: odkrywca_axioms
title: A single causal-code posterior drives local structural change
mechanism: A system represents its sensory stream with a local predictive graph path. Its only selection objective is total prefix code length: Jeffreys integrated local prediction code plus a self-delimiting code for graph size, graph edits, and edit durations, under a hard state-size budget. Posterior inference over paths changes the current topology; the same posterior updates predictive parameters, retains predictive state as memory, and places mass on untested local alternatives as exploration. A reference filter uses p(k)=1/[(k+1)(k+2)] conditioned on capacity, p(d)=1/[d(d+1)], and local Beta(1/2,1/2) codes.
prediction: On fresh seeds 20-39 of the N=4, four 300-step rotating-correlation stream, the posterior-mode graph should exceed 0.90 target-edge coverage, recover within 25 steps on average, maintain less than 0.02 edge occupancy on IID null streams, and never exceed one edge. Mean prequential code length should be below 3.3 bits/step on target streams and 4.1 on null streams.
falsifier: Refuted if the fresh-seed run misses any registered performance bound, if the posterior-mode topology does not change with the correlation regime, or if a bounded online implementation cannot reproduce the reference behavior within the same physical edge cap. The current exact filter is unbounded in inference memory and does not yet realize sampled exploration or return-memory.

history.text: dodana

Prior art: prequential MDL for Bayesian-network/causal structure scoring is explicit in Bornschein et al. 2021 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.05481); online Bayesian run-length inference with duration priors is explicit in Adams and MacKay 2007 (https://arxiv.org/abs/0710.3742). The exact combination of KT segment codes, conditioned graph-size/edit prior, and p(d)=1/[d(d+1)] was not found in these sources, so exact identity is unresolved. The general causal code requires a normalized DAG/factorization; the toy source-target code is predictive and observational. The fixed candidate space and one-edge cap impose topology bounds, all absent edges are scored retrospectively in O(T^2 N) inference, and the code reports MAP rather than a sampled physical path. The updated 20-seed result uses development seeds 0-19; H002's registered fresh seeds 20-39 remain untested. See audit/causal_code_review_2026-10-22.md.

author: odkrywca_life
title: Differential persistence from finite local resource flow
mechanism: Each process carries a local predictive edge and a resource mass. Finite substrate inflow minus maintenance and locally measured predictive dissipation changes that mass; depletion removes the process and its edge, while mass doubling splits it into two inheriting processes. Random edge mutations occur only in resource-funded daughters, so growth, pruning, memory inheritance, and exploration are coupled through one resource-flow law.
prediction: Across hidden regime switches in a reward-free sensory stream, paired populations using cell-specific error costs should shift more mass to the currently predictive edge and achieve lower next-sensory-observation MSE than neutral controls with identical total error expenditure and equal-or-greater random mutation supply; the advantage should persist when resource inflow varies by ±10%.
falsifier: Refute if an independent paired run shows no higher active-edge share and no lower target MSE than both neutral controls, if the advantage disappears at ±10% resource inflow, or if survival requires an added viability, age, or capacity cutoff.

author: odkrywca_life
title: Ecological learning with fission-linked edge exploration
mechanism: Each process carries only a source-edge identity and resource mass. Finite substrate inflow minus maintenance and its binary prediction error updates mass; depletion removes the edge and mass doubling funds equal-mass fission. One daughter inherits the edge and one samples an alternative edge at each fission, with no local estimator or independent mutation-rate clock. Population edge frequencies are the learned state; neutral controls spread the same total error cost across cells.
prediction: In a reward-free 0→1→2→0 stream initialized without edge 2, cell-specific resource costs plus fission-linked variation will raise edge 2 share after its hidden regime and outperform neutral-resource random-fission and clonal controls on active-edge share and target MSE; the effect will persist at ±10% substrate inflow.
falsifier: Refute if the selected arm does not discover and increase the absent edge, does not improve both active-edge share and MSE against the neutral random-fission control across paired seeds, or loses the direction under ±10% substrate supply. The mechanism is not a full one-principle account if edge innovation still requires the explicit daughter-sampling rule.

author: odkrywca_life
title: Typed resource flow materializes exploratory edges
mechanism: Finite substrate packets carry a uniform candidate-edge label and are apportioned to extant cells. A cell's scalar mass integrates tagged intake minus maintenance and local binary prediction error. Depletion removes the cell and edge; mass-doubling funds equal-mass fission. One daughter inherits the edge and the other takes the latest packet label, so exploration is encoded in structural resource flow rather than a separate mutation operator or mutation-rate parameter. Population composition is the learned and remembered state.
prediction: In a reward-free 0→1→2→0 stream initialized without edge 2, cell-specific resource costs with tagged fission will raise the absent edge's abundance and outperform a neutral tagged-resource control on active-edge share and target MSE; the effect will persist under ±10% substrate supply.
falsifier: Refute if the absent source fails to appear and increase, if selected tagged flow does not beat neutral tagged flow on both active-edge share and target MSE across paired seeds, or if the direction disappears under ±10% supply. Treat as incomplete if results require resource tags to encode candidate edges without a principled source for those tags.
